newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine 1997 H1 unmilled rice output seen up.
newsitem.headline: Philippine 1997 H1 unmilled rice output seen up.

text.p: Philippine unmilled rice output is expected to increase to 4.991 million tonnes in the first six months of the year from 4.951 million in the same period in 1996, state-agency Bureau of Agricultural Statistics said on Wednesday.
Unmilled rice output is forecast to increase to 2.68 million tonnes from January to March this year from the year-ago 2.524 million tonnes.
The harvests from April to June, however, are expected to drop to 2.311 million tonnes from the year-ago 2.427 million.
The BAS said it expected total rice harvest area in the first half of the year to drop to 1.657 million hectares from the year-ago 1.666 million.
However, average yield per hectare is seen rising to 3.01 tonnes per hectare from the year-ago 2.97 tonnes per hectare.
